heading: INT. CONVENT WINE CELLAR - NORTHERN ITALY - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CONVENT WINE CELLAR - NORTHERN ITALY - NIGHT
Vaulted brick, rows of dusty barrels, a single oil lamp on an upturned crate.
Overhead, far away, the dull thump of artillery.
Dust sifts from the ceiling with each one.
LIEUTENANT HOLLIS WEBB (30s, American, clean-shaven despite everything, map case at his hip) sits on a barrel, writing in a notebook.
CORPORAL TUCKER MAYES (20s, freckled, helmet pushed back) stands guard at the foot of the stone stairs, rifle slung.
A MAN in a ragged civilian coat sits on the floor in the shadows, hands resting on his knees.
He is gaunt, gray at the temples, and watches the lamp rather than the soldiers.
Lieutenant, he's still not saying a word.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Give him time.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Been an hour, sir.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Been four years for him.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Another thump.
Dust falls.
The lamp flame shivers.
That one's closer.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: They're walking it down the valley. It'll pass us by morning.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: How do you know?
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Because it's the same gun, the same interval. Count with me. Twenty seconds, then the next one lands a little to the left.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: You been counting?
units.name: MAYES

units.text: It's what there is to do.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Mayes shifts his weight.
Looks at the stranger, then back.
Sir, if he's a spy, he's a bad one. Nobody sneaks in and then sits down to wait.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Nobody said spy.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Sergeant Pruitt said spy.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Sergeant Pruitt says a lot of things.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: He said it twice.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: He says everything twice. It's how you know he means it, or doesn't.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: The STRANGER lifts his head.
His English is careful, formal.
It is the Abbess's wine you are sitting on.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: We'll try not to drink it.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: She would be angry if you did not.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Webb closes the notebook.
Mayes straightens, hand drifting toward his rifle, then stops.
You speak English.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: I taught it. Before. At the school in Cremona.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: What's your name?
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Anselm.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Anselm what?
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Only Anselm. The rest belongs to a man who no longer exists.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: That's a hell of a thing to say.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: It is a hell of a year.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Anselm, we're dug in here until the line moves. Nobody's going to hurt you. We just need to know who else is in this convent.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Nine sisters. Two children from the village. One goat.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: A goat?
units.name: MAYES

units.text: She gives good milk. You will want to thank her.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Where are they now?
units.name: WEBB

units.text: In the chapel, praying very quietly. They are afraid of your Corporal.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Me?
units.name: MAYES

units.text: You walk like a man who expects to be shot at.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: I do expect to be shot at.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Yes. That is why they are afraid.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Webb almost smiles.
Another thump, softer this time.
No one flinches.
That one was farther.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: They are walking it down the valley.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: So I hear.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Lieutenant, permission to ask something?
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Go ahead.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Why are we being so polite?
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Because it's night, and it's cold, and the only war in this room right now is between your stomach and the rations.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: That's a war I'm losing.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: There is bread upstairs. And cheese. The sisters will not offer. You must ask.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Mayes, go ask.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Sir, my post.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: I have the post. Go ask nicely.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: Nicely. Yes, sir.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Mayes starts up the stairs, pauses halfway.
Do I say please in Italian?
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Per favore. And you bow your head. Slightly.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Per favore.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Less like you are giving an order.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Per favore.
units.name: MAYES

units.text: Better.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: Mayes climbs out of sight.
Webb opens the notebook again, then turns it face down on his knee.
You must have been a good teacher.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: I was a patient one. It is not the same.
units.name: ANSELM

units.text: It's most of it.
units.name: WEBB

units.text: The lamp steadies.
Above them, a faint scrape of boots on stone, and then a woman's voice, very small, saying something that might be a blessing.
